[EN] They brought me here to protect the teleportal to Ebon Tower.

The stench of blood, though...it's nearly impossible to tolerate. Blood Magician or not, this is too much.
[ES] Me trajeron aquí para proteger el teleportal a Ebon Tower.

Sin embargo, el hedor a sangre... es casi imposible de tolerar. Sé un Blood Magician o no, esto es demasiado.
